title: Street Fighter Collection
overview:
The Greatest Collection of Fighter Has Just Entered the Arena.

We've hit you with a Super Combo! 3 Monumental releases featuring 27 fighters from the series that defined fighting games. Battle your way through your all time favorites: Super Street Fighter II, Super Street Fighter II Turbo, and the U.S. debut of Street Fighter Alpha 2 Dash, brought home in their true arcade form for the first time.
